recognition.description: Can a normal viewer roughly identify the hobby within about 2 seconds without the title?

collectible_desirability.description: Does the image feel desirable enough to collect, not merely correct?

composition.description: Is there a strong focal hierarchy and visually satisfying card-friendly composition?

zync_style_consistency.description: Does it belong to the same premium illustrated Zync universe?

technical_coherence.description: Are key objects, anatomy, gear, scene logic, and text absence coherent?

pass_rules.hard_case: no score below 3, Recognition >= 4, and average >= 4.0
